title: Compile repeated-residency typed evidence into horizon/price policy regions
question: Can the hosted P9-011 typed frontier be compiled into exact policy regions without inventing a scalar objective, using hard capacity/latency feasibility first and only an externally supplied RAM price when both policies remain feasible?
preregistered_gates: hard capacity and latency feasibility are applied before any external price
when both policies remain feasible and no external price is supplied, decision remains TYPED_FRONTIER_UNRESOLVED
compiled region lookup matches an independent direct priced-cost solver over at least 1000 boundary-focused comparisons
break-even external RAM price rises monotonically over the frozen reuse horizons
policy compilation does not grant execution authority or retry permission
